title: shadPS4 0.13.0: official development build
summary: shadPS4 published 0.13.0 on December 24, 2025. The release record documents an official development build for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.13.0 on December 24, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official release description states: Here we are again with an early Christmas present. Santa might not have reached your home yet, but shadPS4 will. This release brings the long-awaited Bloodborne speedup fix, along with a lot of AJM fixes from our great Roamic dev, who was kind enough to resolve some weird sound issues (God of War 3 and other games now almost have perfect sound).
